checkpoints.summary: Wrote and self-reviewed the OMNIVISION Epistemic Control Plane v2 design after a multi-source capability and methodology evidence sweep. The design adds source-capability state, semantic relevance firewall, provenance DAG, search-aware trial ledger, confidence decomposition, abstention, staleness, negative knowledge, causal discipline, expected-information-gain budgeting, proof-carrying candidates, and recursive invalidation.
design_decisions: No v2 product code may land before runtime verification and remediation of the existing foundation.
External source availability is versioned capability state, not a permanent assumption.
Search history and rejected trials are part of evidentiary burden.
Reachable but semantically irrelevant sources are rejected before normalization.
Vendor duplication does not count as independent evidence when providers relay the same upstream source.
Confidence is decomposed and abstention is first-class.
Invalidated evidence must propagate to downstream candidates via provenance lineage.
